title: Falling Squares Simulation

monster.name: Tetris Golem
monster.title: Stacker of Heavy Cubes
monster.defeatQuote: Interval coordinate height compression tracked max elevation!

description: There are several squares being dropped onto an X-axis. You are given a 2D integer array `positions` where `positions[i] = [left_i, sideLength_i]`. Return an array of the maximum height of the stack of squares after each square is dropped.
solutionCode:
def fallingSquaresSimulator(positions: list[list[int]]) -> list[int]:
    intervals = []
    res = []
    max_h = 0
    for left, size in positions:
        right = left + size
        h = size
        for l, r, prev_h in intervals:
            if not (right <= l or left >= r):
                h = max(h, prev_h + size)
        intervals.append((left, right, h))
        max_h = max(max_h, h)
        res.append(max_h)
    return res
hints: Track interval heights. When dropping [left, right], base height is max overlapping interval height.

python.solutionCode:
def fallingSquaresSimulator(positions: list[list[int]]) -> list[int]:
    intervals = []
    res = []
    max_h = 0
    for left, size in positions:
        right = left + size
        h = size
        for l, r, prev_h in intervals:
            if not (right <= l or left >= r):
                h = max(h, prev_h + size)
        intervals.append((left, right, h))
        max_h = max(max_h, h)
        res.append(max_h)
    return res
